Thanks Ben — copying our concerns here in a redline-friendly way. I reviewed OrderForm_Draft_v2 and prepared a short redline doc; attaching as redlines_orderform.docx. High-level legal asks: 

1) Invoice recipient: draft the clause to allow Redwood to invoice either (a) OrionHealth, Inc. (primary) or (b) the OrionHealth entity identified on the PO, provided the PO explicitly references this order. This prevents mis-routing if AP submits an alternate remit entity.
2) Tax evidence: request include a requirement that the customer provide VAT registration certificate for any EU-entity invoicing within 10 business days of execution; otherwise Redwood will invoice the US entity and withhold VAT where applicable.
3) Net terms: clarify Net30 as baseline; include a commercial exception that allows Net45 for committed reserved capacity agreements only with written acknowledgement in the Order Form.
4) Invoice content: require PO number be present on each invoice line item or the invoice may be returned for correction (helps AP automation).

I noted two commercial items for sales to close with finance: (i) whether Redwood will accept a split invoice workflow (adds operational overhead) and (ii) whether to accept Net45 for the first 12 months as part of the onboarding concessions. Karthik — can you confirm Finance's position on net terms flexibility?

Kimberly Park
